description: This is a test class for the EmployeeTimesheetListAPI in the OrangeHRM time API plugin. It performs unit tests on the API endpoints related to employee timesheets, including retrieving all timesheets, and checks that unsupported methods throw NotImplementedExceptions.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetListAPITest
classes.description: This class contains automated test cases for the EmployeeTimesheetListAPI, verifying the correct functionality and handling of the API endpoints related to employee timesheets.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all employee timesheets using the API, with different test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the 'testGetAll' method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the create method in the API class throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for create operation throws the expected exception as it is not implemented.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Checks that calling delete on the API throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures the validation rule for delete operation throws the expected exception as it is not implemented.
